title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Can every smooth Hamiltonian map on billiard phase space be approximated smoothly by composing reflections in the original surface and arbitrarily small prescribed smooth perturbations, without adding inverse reflections?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200008 (AMR-051-0008). CC BY 4.0.

M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Alexey Glutsyuk, Problem 2 and remarks, pp. 6--7.
